versions.changelog:
- Initial release of SOL/Crypto Momentum Trader template for Polymarket on Simmer.
- Trades crypto prediction markets (Solana, Bitcoin, Ethereum) based on CoinGecko price momentum signals.
- Automates market discovery, edge detection, and trade execution with built-in context checks for flip-flop detection and slippage protection.
- All configuration via environment variables; supports dry-run and live trading modes.
- Includes safeguards such as trade limits, slippage checks, and Simmer context recommendations.
- Designed for easy signal source remixing and strategy customization.
